heavy_gauge_source: One-loop DR matching with one 5H, 5barH and degenerate adjoint fragments; no gauge kinetic spurion. For the numerical Yukawa example set MX = MSigma = QG.
flavour_contract: From 10 PeV to QG continue MSSM Yukawa equations with four high neutral columns as registered, plus gauge-only complete vectorlike pairs and no other Yukawa couplings. Keep the labelled ordinary three-family block in one common family frame at QG. No finite family-dependent threshold corrections. Only ordinary charged and gauge variables are fit.
